title: Spectroscopic, electrochemical, thermodynamic and theoretical insights into solvent effects for the intensification of the modified OxFA process
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22572-22586
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02899C, Paper
Open Access

Jan-Dominik H. Krueger, Pegah Saedi, Maximilian J. Poller, Dzmitry H. Zaitsau, Riko Siewert, David Robinson, Karsten Müller, Jakob Albert
The effects of co-solvents on the catalytic efficiency of xylose oxidation to formic acid in the modified OxFA process were explored by a combination of spectroscopic, electrochemical and thermodynamic measurements, as well as DFT modelling.
